summary: Base Pydantic model (AuthSpec) for the discriminated-union auth schema system. All auth types inherit from this class.

key_classes.name: AuthSpec
key_classes.summary: Frozen Pydantic BaseModel with extra='forbid'. Subclasses declare a Literal 'kind' field used as discriminator.

extension_points: Subclass AuthSpec with a new Literal 'kind' to add a new auth type
lifecycle_notes: Base class intentionally omits 'kind' field to avoid reportIncompatibleVariableOverride in subclasses
documentation_hooks: Explain the discriminated union pattern for auth types
Show how to add a new auth type

evidence.detail: Tests exercise NoAuth, PasswordAuth, OAuth2AuthCodeAuth, OAuth1Auth
